modifications: layernorm_gated.py (native-PyTorch RMSNormGated): adds sigmoid gating, rmsnorm(x) * sigmoid(z), used by the Qwen3.8 Gated-DeltaNet output norm.

qwen4_exp.py + server_args.py (PLE & whole-model language_model_only DecoderTpuCompilePolicy, via q38_qwen4_exp_tpu_ple.py): registers Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration in LANGUAGE_MODEL_ONLY_ARCHITECTURES; uses NamedTuple _PLEBatch with static padded shapes and flat token-major EXTEND layout; zero-masks fresh-request short-conv state and sets EOS n-gram history in-graph; evaluates the 3-gram hash via exact 6x12-bit int32 limb arithmetic; uses root index_put_ pool updates; and compiles LogitsProcessor + lm_head in-graph when language_model_only=True (supporting DP=2 dp-attention and MTP hc_hidden_states outputs).
ple_state_pool.py (NGramPool): uses int32 storage and root index_put_ updates in set_intermediate_context for TPU XLA and direct_compile compatibility.

qwen4_exp_mtp.py + rotary_embedding/{base,mrope}.py + hyperconnection.py + sglang_tpu MTP/direct_compile: uses int32 prefix sums in Qwen4ExpForCausalLMMTP; preserves full verify rows in _set_hc_logits_hidden_states; disables inner torch.compile wrappers on partial-RoPE apply_rotary_emb and GatedResidual._mix_compute/_combine_compute under outer make_fx tracing; lifts req_index_to_mamba_index_mapping + ShortConvPool + NGramPool buffers in HybridLinearKVPoolState; supports hc_count=4 (10,240-dim stream carry + _mix_streams before lm_head) in TpuMtpDraftWorker; and uses static-shape int32 PLE state commit in HybridLinearAttnBackend.

modelopt_quant.py + qwen2_moe.py + fused_rs/{fused_moe,gmm_fused_rs_nodedup}.py: sets TpuModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod.use_flashinfer_trtllm_weight_layout = False, enables allow_backend_reduction=True on Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock for FP4 configs, scales TP-summed Pallas fused-RS routed outputs by 1/tp_size before adding the unreduced shared expert, widens non-SP fused-RS routing broadcast from bfloat16 to float32 for 512-expert routing indices, and updates Pallas semaphore calls to pl.* for JAX 0.11+.
